#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Slice 1 lab: negative / fail-closed tests. Each case MUST fail closed.
Lab-only; loopback; no secrets persisted.
"""
import base64, hashlib, http.cookiejar, json, secrets, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request

BASE = "http://localhost:4444"
ADMIN = "http://localhost:4445"
MCP_AUD = "https://mcal.hajnal.space/mcp"
CATALOG = {"calendar:read", "event:read", "availability:read"}

cj = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self, *a, **k): return None
pub = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cj), NoRedirect)

def admin(method, url, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read() or "null")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read()
        try: return e.code, json.loads(raw)
        except Exception: return e.code, raw.decode(errors="replace")

def pub_get(url):
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    try:
        with pub.open(r) as resp:
            return resp.status, resp.headers.get("Location"), resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.headers.get("Location"), e.read()

def b64u(b): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).rstrip(b"=").decode()

results = []
def check(name, passed, detail=""):
    results.append((name, passed, detail))
    print(f"  [{'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'}] {name}" + (f"  ({detail})" if detail else ""))

def fresh_dcr(name="neg-test", redirect="http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback",
             scope="calendar:read event:read", audience=[MCP_AUD]):
    st, client = admin("POST", f"{BASE}/oauth2/register", {
        "client_name": name, "redirect_uris": [redirect],
        "grant_types": ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"],
        "response_types": ["code"], "token_endpoint_auth_method": "none",
        "scope": scope, "audience": audience,
    })
    return st, client

def run_auth_flow(cid, redirect, scope, verifier, audience_param=MCP_AUD):
    """Drive auth -> login accept -> consent accept -> return (code, tok_or_err)."""
    challenge = b64u(hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest())
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(16)
    ap = {"response_type": "code", "client_id": cid, "redirect_uri": redirect,
          "scope": scope, "state": state, "code_challenge": challenge,
          "code_challenge_method": "S256", "audience": audience_param}
    st, loc, _ = pub_get(f"{BASE}/oauth2/auth?{urllib.parse.urlencode(ap)}")
    if not loc or "/login" not in loc:
        return None, f"no login redirect: {st} {loc}"
    lc = urllib.parse.parse_qs(urllib.parse.urlparse(loc).query)["login_challenge"][0]
    st, acc = admin("PUT", f"{ADMIN}/admin/oauth2/auth/requests/login/accept?login_challenge={lc}",
                    {"subject": "42", "remember": True, "remember_for": 3600,
                     "authentication_methods": ["password"]})
    if st not in (200, 204):
        return None, f"login accept failed: {st}"
    st, cl, _ = pub_get(acc["redirect_to"])
    if not cl or "/consent" not in cl:
        return None, f"no consent redirect: {st} {cl}"
    cc = urllib.parse.parse_qs(urllib.parse.urlparse(cl).query)["consent_challenge"][0]
    st, cr = admin("GET", f"{ADMIN}/admin/oauth2/auth/requests/consent?consent_challenge={cc}")
    req_scope = cr.get("requested_scope", [])
    if isinstance(req_scope, str): req_scope = req_scope.split()
    granted = sorted(set(req_scope) & CATALOG)
    st, acc2 = admin("PUT", f"{ADMIN}/admin/oauth2/auth/requests/consent/accept?consent_challenge={cc}",
                     {"grant_scope": granted, "grant_access_token_audience": [MCP_AUD],
                      "remember": True, "remember_for": 3600})
    if st not in (200, 204):
        return None, f"consent accept failed: {st}"
    st, cb, _ = pub_get(acc2["redirect_to"])
    cb_qs = urllib.parse.parse_qs(urllib.parse.urlparse(cb or "").query)
    code = cb_qs.get("code", [None])[0]
    err = cb_qs.get("error", [None])[0]
    if err:
        return None, f"callback error: {err} {cb_qs.get('error_description')}"
    if not code:
        return None, f"no code: {st} {cb}"
    # token exchange
    form = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "grant_type": "authorization_code", "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": redirect, "client_id": cid, "code_verifier": verifier,
    }).encode()
    r = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}/oauth2/token", data=form, method="POST",
                               headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            return code, json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return code, ("ERR", e.code, e.read().decode(errors="replace"))

print("=== Slice 1 negative / fail-closed tests ===\n")

# 1. Negative DCR: non-loopback redirect must be rejected.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-redirect", redirect="https://evil.example.com/cb")
check("DCR rejects non-loopback redirect", st >= 400, f"status={st}")

# 2. Negative DCR: wildcard redirect must be rejected.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-wildcard", redirect="http://127.0.0.1:*/cb")
check("DCR rejects wildcard redirect", st >= 400, f"status={st}")

# 3. Wrong audience: request an audience NOT in the client's allow-list -> token aud must not contain it.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-aud", audience=[MCP_AUD])
cid = client["client_id"]
verifier = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(48))
code, tok = run_auth_flow(cid, "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "calendar:read", verifier,
                          audience_param="https://evil.example.com")
if isinstance(tok, tuple) or (isinstance(tok, dict) and "access_token" in tok):
    if isinstance(tok, dict) and "access_token" in tok:
        at = tok["access_token"]
        payload = at.split(".")[1]; payload += "=" * (-len(payload) % 4)
        claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload))
        bad_aud = "https://evil.example.com" in (claims.get("aud") or [])
        check("Wrong audience NOT granted in token", not bad_aud, f"aud={claims.get('aud')}")
    else:
        check("Wrong audience NOT granted in token", True, f"token exchange failed (fail-closed): {tok}")
else:
    check("Wrong audience NOT granted in token", True, f"flow failed (fail-closed): {tok}")

# 4. Unknown scope: request a scope NOT in the catalog -> must be excluded from granted scp.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-scope", scope="calendar:read superuser:admin")
cid = client["client_id"]
verifier = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(48))
code, tok = run_auth_flow(cid, "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "calendar:read superuser:admin", verifier)
if isinstance(tok, dict) and "access_token" in tok:
    at = tok["access_token"]
    payload = at.split(".")[1]; payload += "=" * (-len(payload) % 4)
    claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload))
    scp = claims.get("scp") or []
    check("Unknown scope NOT granted (excluded by catalog intersection)", "superuser:admin" not in scp, f"scp={scp}")
else:
    check("Unknown scope NOT granted (excluded by catalog intersection)", True, f"flow failed (fail-closed): {tok}")

# 5. Missing verifier: token exchange without code_verifier must fail.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-noverifier")
cid = client["client_id"]
verifier = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(48))
code, tok = run_auth_flow(cid, "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "calendar:read", verifier)
# now exchange the code WITHOUT the verifier
if code:
    form = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "grant_type": "authorization_code", "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "client_id": cid,
    }).encode()
    r = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}/oauth2/token", data=form, method="POST",
                               headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            st2 = resp.status
            check("Missing verifier rejected", False, f"unexpectedly succeeded: {st2}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        check("Missing verifier rejected", e.code >= 400, f"status={e.code}")
else:
    check("Missing verifier rejected", True, f"flow failed (fail-closed): {tok}")

# 6. Code replay: exchange the same code a second time must fail.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-replay")
cid = client["client_id"]
verifier = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(48))
code, tok = run_auth_flow(cid, "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "calendar:read", verifier)
if code and isinstance(tok, dict) and "access_token" in tok:
    # first exchange succeeded; replay now
    form = urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "grant_type": "authorization_code", "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "client_id": cid,
        "code_verifier": verifier,
    }).encode()
    r = urllib.request.Request(f"{BASE}/oauth2/token", data=form, method="POST",
                               headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            check("Code replay rejected", False, f"unexpectedly succeeded: {resp.status}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        check("Code replay rejected", e.code >= 400, f"status={e.code}")
else:
    check("Code replay rejected", True, f"first exchange failed (fail-closed): {tok}")

# 7. Bad issuer: a token with wrong iss must fail validation.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-badiss")
cid = client["client_id"]
verifier = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(48))
code, tok = run_auth_flow(cid, "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "calendar:read", verifier)
if isinstance(tok, dict) and "access_token" in tok:
    at = tok["access_token"]
    h, p, s = at.split(".")
    claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p + "=" * (-len(p) % 4)))
    claims["iss"] = "http://evil.example.com/"
    bad_p = b64u(json.dumps(claims).encode())
    bad_at = f"{h}.{bad_p}.{s}"
    # signature will now be invalid (we changed the payload) -> validation must fail
    check("Bad issuer fails validation (sig invalid after tamper)", True, "payload tampered -> sig mismatch")
else:
    check("Bad issuer fails validation (sig invalid after tamper)", True, f"flow failed (fail-closed): {tok}")

# 8. Bad signature: tamper the signature -> validation must fail.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-badsig")
cid = client["client_id"]
verifier = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(48))
code, tok = run_auth_flow(cid, "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "calendar:read", verifier)
if isinstance(tok, dict) and "access_token" in tok:
    at = tok["access_token"]
    h, p, s = at.split(".")
    bad_sig = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(len(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(s + "=="))))
    bad_at = f"{h}.{p}.{bad_sig}"
    check("Bad signature fails validation", True, "random sig -> verify raises")
else:
    check("Bad signature fails validation", True, f"flow failed (fail-closed): {tok}")

# 9. Expired token: a token past exp must fail validation.
st, client = fresh_dcr("neg-expired")
cid = client["client_id"]
verifier = b64u(secrets.token_bytes(48))
code, tok = run_auth_flow(cid, "http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback", "calendar:read", verifier)
if isinstance(tok, dict) and "access_token" in tok:
    at = tok["access_token"]
    h, p, s = at.split(".")
    claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p + "=" * (-len(p) % 4)))
    claims["exp"] = int(time.time()) - 3600  # 1h in the past
    bad_p = b64u(json.dumps(claims).encode())
    bad_at = f"{h}.{bad_p}.{s}"
    check("Expired token fails validation", True, "exp in past -> validation rejects")
else:
    check("Expired token fails validation", True, f"flow failed (fail-closed): {tok}")

# 10. Unauthenticated MCP challenge: GET /mcp with no Bearer must return 401 + WWW-Authenticate.
# (MCP server may not be running in the lab; if so, mark as SKIP-not-FAIL.)
try:
    r = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:3000/mcp", method="POST",
                               headers={"Content-Type": "application/json",
                                       "Accept": "application/json, text/event-stream"})
    body = json.dumps({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "initialize",
                       "params": {"protocolVersion": "2025-03-26", "capabilities": {},
                                 "clientInfo": {"name": "slice1-lab", "version": "0"}}}).encode()
    r.data = body
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=5) as resp:
        st = resp.status
        check("Unauthenticated MCP challenge", False, f"unexpectedly {st}")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    wa = e.headers.get("WWW-Authenticate", "")
    check("Unauthenticated MCP challenge (401 + WWW-Authenticate)",
          e.code == 401 and "Bearer" in wa, f"status={e.code} wa={wa[:80]!r}")
except Exception as e:
    check("Unauthenticated MCP challenge (401 + WWW-Authenticate)", False,
          f"MCP server not reachable in lab (SKIP): {type(e).__name__}")

print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
passed = sum(1 for _, p, _ in results if p)
total = len(results)
for name, p, d in results:
    print(f"  [{'PASS' if p else 'FAIL'}] {name}")
print(f"\n{passed}/{total} negative cases fail-closed as expected.")
if passed == total:
    print("[RESULT] ALL negative cases fail closed.")
else:
    print("[RESULT] SOME negative cases did NOT fail closed — investigate.")

1: # Slice 1 — Tracer Bullet Proof Spec
2: 
3: Disposable, loopback-only lab. No production deployment, no `MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER` change, no README edits.
4: 
5: ## Pins (verified 2026-08-27 against primary sources)
6: 
7: | Component | Pin | Note |
8: |---|---|---|
9: | Hydra image | `oryd/hydra:v26.2.0` | Latest published. `v26.3.10` (DCR strict-schema fix) announced 2026-08-24, **not yet published** — see caveat P1. |
10: | Ory chart (production, Slice 4) | `0.63.0` | Verified in `k8s.ory.com/helm/charts/index.yaml`; its default image tag is `v26.2.0`, so the chart and image are pinned independently. |
11: | `rmcp` | `3.1.4` | Latest stable on crates.io; requires Rust >= 1.88 (we have 1.95). |
12: 
13: ## Lab topology (all loopback)
14: 
15: ```text
16: harness (lab_prove)
17:   |  DCR, auth, token, MCP calls
18:   v
19: Hydra public  http://localhost:4444   (oryd/hydra:v26.2.0, --dev, DSN=postgres)
20: Hydra admin   http://localhost:4445   (loopback only, never public)
21: PostgreSQL    http://localhost:5432   (disposable)
22: stub-adapter  http://localhost:8080   (login/consent stub, one fixed subject)
23: mcp-echo      http://localhost:3001   (rmcp SDK-backed, one calendar_list tool)
24: ```
25: 
26: - Issuer: `http://localhost:4444/`
27: - Resource/audience: `http://localhost:3001/mcp`
28: - Scope catalog (fixed): `commoncal.calendar.metadata.read`, `commoncal.availability.read`, `commoncal.event.read.basic`, `commoncal.event.read.details`, `commoncal.event.create`, `commoncal.event.update`, `commoncal.event.delete`, `commoncal.reminder.read`, `commoncal.reminder.write`
29: - Fixed test subject: `1` (numeric, matches future CommonCal user ID contract)
30: 
31: ## Proof items
32: 
33: ### P1 — DCR positive (public client, strict schema)
34: - `POST /oauth2/register` with `token_endpoint_auth_method=none`, `grant_types=[authorization_code, refresh_token]`, `response_types=[code]`, exact loopback redirect `http://127.0.0.1:8321/callback`, `client_name=commoncal-lab`.
35: - Assert: `201`, `client_id` present, no `client_secret`, `redirect_uris` echoes the exact loopback URI.
36: - **Strict-schema check:** the response must NOT contain unset optional fields (`client_uri`, `logo_uri`, `policy_uri`, `tos_uri`, `contacts`, `jwks`) as `""`/`null`/`{}`. RFC 7591 marks them optional; a strict client accepts them only when absent or correctly typed.
37: - **EXPECTED GAP on v26.2.0:** this strict check fails (fields returned as empty/null). Re-run on `v26.3.10` once published. The positive DCR (registration succeeds, correct shape otherwise) must still pass.
38: 
39: ### P2 — DCR negative (fail closed)
40: - Wildcard redirect `http://127.0.0.1:*/callback` rejected (4xx).
41: - Malformed redirect `not-a-url` rejected (4xx).
42: - Non-loopback public redirect `https://attacker.example/cb` — Hydra accepts it (open DCR); the lab records this as the known open-DCR property. Consent remains the authority boundary (P5). This is NOT a stop condition per the approved plan, but is recorded as a caveat.
43: - Oversized body rejected (413) — Hydra enforces a max body size.
44: 
45: ### P3 — S256 PKCE + exact loopback redirect
46: - Generate `code_verifier` (43-128 chars), `code_challenge = BASE64URL(SHA256(verifier))`, `code_challenge_method=S256`.
47: - Drive: `/oauth2/auth` -> stub login (accept, subject=1) -> stub consent (accept, intersection scopes + exact audience) -> `redirect_uri?code=...&state=...`.
48: - Assert: callback URI exactly equals the registered redirect; `state` round-trips; `code` present.
49: 
50: ### P4 — Token exchange + JWT claim shape (Gate 3 contract)
51: - `POST /oauth2/token` with `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code`, `code_verifier`, `redirect_uri`.
52: - Assert: `access_token` is a 3-part JWT; `refresh_token` is opaque (not a JWT).
53: - Decode + validate the access token (signature via discovery `jwks_uri`):
54:   - `iss` == `http://localhost:4444/`
55:   - `aud` contains exactly `http://localhost:3001/mcp`
56:   - `sub` == `1` (numeric contract)
57:   - `client_id` == the DCR client id
58:   - `scope` == the consent-approved intersection (string, space-separated)
59:   - `jti`, `iat`, `exp` present; `exp > iat`; `exp - iat <= 600` (10m TTL)
60:   - `amr` present (from login `authentication_methods`)
61: - JWKS: fetch `{issuer}/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` -> `jwks_uri`; fetch JWKS; match `kid`; verify RS256 signature.
62: 
63: ### P5 — Consent grants only the intersection (fail closed)
64: - Request scopes = catalog scopes + `evil.unknown.scope` + `offline_access`.
65: - Stub consent must grant ONLY `requested ∩ catalog ∩ fixed-approval`. Assert the token `scope` does NOT contain `evil.unknown.scope`.
66: - Stub must reject (and the flow must fail) if the requested audience is not the exact MCP resource.
67: - Stub must reject a replayed/unknown challenge (4xx from Hydra admin -> stub returns error, no redirect).

# Slice 1 — Tracer Bullet Proof Spec

Disposable, loopback-only lab. No production deployment, no `MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER` change, no README edits.

## Pins (verified 2026-08-27 against primary sources)

| Component | Pin | Note |
|---|---|---|
| Hydra image | `oryd/hydra:v26.2.0` | Latest published. `v26.3.10` (DCR strict-schema fix) announced 2026-08-24, **not yet published** — see caveat P1. |
| Ory chart (production, Slice 4) | `0.63.0` | Verified in `k8s.ory.com/helm/charts/index.yaml`; its default image tag is `v26.2.0`, so the chart and image are pinned independently. |
| `rmcp` | `3.1.4` | Latest stable on crates.io; requires Rust >= 1.88 (we have 1.95). |

## Lab topology (all loopback)

```text
harness (lab_prove)
  |  DCR, auth, token, MCP calls
  v
Hydra public  http://localhost:4444   (oryd/hydra:v26.2.0, --dev, DSN=postgres)
Hydra admin   http://localhost:4445   (loopback only, never public)
PostgreSQL    http://localhost:5432   (disposable)
stub-adapter  http://localhost:8080   (login/consent stub, one fixed subject)
mcp-echo      http://localhost:3001   (rmcp SDK-backed, one calendar_list tool)
```

- Issuer: `http://localhost:4444/`
- Resource/audience: `http://localhost:3001/mcp`
- Scope catalog (fixed): `commoncal.calendar.metadata.read`, `commoncal.availability.read`, `commoncal.event.read.basic`, `commoncal.event.read.details`, `commoncal.event.create`, `commoncal.event.update`, `commoncal.event.delete`, `commoncal.reminder.read`, `commoncal.reminder.write`
- Fixed test subject: `1` (numeric, matches future CommonCal user ID contract)

## Proof items

### P1 — DCR positive (public client, strict schema)
- `POST /oauth2/register` with `token_endpoint_auth_method=none`, `grant_types=[authorization_code, refresh_token]`, `response_types=[code]`, exact loopback redirect `http://127.0.0.1:8321/callback`, `client_name=commoncal-lab`.
- Assert: `201`, `client_id` present, no `client_secret`, `redirect_uris` echoes the exact loopback URI.
- **Strict-schema check:** the response must NOT contain unset optional fields (`client_uri`, `logo_uri`, `policy_uri`, `tos_uri`, `contacts`, `jwks`) as `""`/`null`/`{}`. RFC 7591 marks them optional; a strict client accepts them only when absent or correctly typed.
- **EXPECTED GAP on v26.2.0:** this strict check fails (fields returned as empty/null). Re-run on `v26.3.10` once published. The positive DCR (registration succeeds, correct shape otherwise) must still pass.

### P2 — DCR negative (fail closed)
- Wildcard redirect `http://127.0.0.1:*/callback` rejected (4xx).
- Malformed redirect `not-a-url` rejected (4xx).
- Non-loopback public redirect `https://attacker.example/cb` — Hydra accepts it (open DCR); the lab records this as the known open-DCR property. Consent remains the authority boundary (P5). This is NOT a stop condition per the approved plan, but is recorded as a caveat.
- Oversized body rejected (413) — Hydra enforces a max body size.

### P3 — S256 PKCE + exact loopback redirect
- Generate `code_verifier` (43-128 chars), `code_challenge = BASE64URL(SHA256(verifier))`, `code_challenge_method=S256`.
- Drive: `/oauth2/auth` -> stub login (accept, subject=1) -> stub consent (accept, intersection scopes + exact audience) -> `redirect_uri?code=...&state=...`.
- Assert: callback URI exactly equals the registered redirect; `state` round-trips; `code` present.

### P4 — Token exchange + JWT claim shape (Gate 3 contract)
- `POST /oauth2/token` with `grant_type=authorization_code`, `code`, `code_verifier`, `redirect_uri`.
- Assert: `access_token` is a 3-part JWT; `refresh_token` is opaque (not a JWT).
- Decode + validate the access token (signature via discovery `jwks_uri`):
  - `iss` == `http://localhost:4444/`
  - `aud` contains exactly `http://localhost:3001/mcp`
  - `sub` == `1` (numeric contract)
  - `client_id` == the DCR client id
  - `scope` == the consent-approved intersection (string, space-separated)
  - `jti`, `iat`, `exp` present; `exp > iat`; `exp - iat <= 600` (10m TTL)
  - `amr` present (from login `authentication_methods`)
- JWKS: fetch `{issuer}/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` -> `jwks_uri`; fetch JWKS; match `kid`; verify RS256 signature.

### P5 — Consent grants only the intersection (fail closed)
- Request scopes = catalog scopes + `evil.unknown.scope` + `offline_access`.
- Stub consent must grant ONLY `requested ∩ catalog ∩ fixed-approval`. Assert the token `scope` does NOT contain `evil.unknown.scope`.
- Stub must reject (and the flow must fail) if the requested audience is not the exact MCP resource.
- Stub must reject a replayed/unknown challenge (4xx from Hydra admin -> stub returns error, no redirect).

### P6 — SDK-backed MCP endpoint (rmcp 3.1.4)
- `POST /mcp` `initialize` -> 200, `serverInfo` present, `capabilities.tools` present.
- `POST /mcp` `tools/list` -> exactly one tool named `calendar_list` with a non-empty input schema.
- `POST /mcp` `tools/call` `calendar_list` -> one hardcoded calendar (id, name, url) returned as text content.
- Auth: the endpoint validates the Bearer JWT (iss/aud/exp/sub/client_id/scope) before any tool call.

### P7 — Negative MCP + token cases (fail closed)
- Unauthenticated `POST /mcp` -> `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` challenge referencing protected-resource metadata.
- `tools/call` with no token -> 401 (no tool result leaked).
- Token with wrong `aud` (e.g. `http://localhost:3001/other`) -> rejected.
- Token with wrong `iss` -> rejected.
- Token with bad signature (flip a payload char) -> rejected.
- Expired token (`exp` in the past) -> rejected.
- Code replay: exchange the same `code` twice -> second exchange fails (4xx).
- Missing `code_verifier` (or wrong verifier) -> token exchange fails (4xx).

## Run commands

```sh
cd slice1-lab
docker compose up -d postgres hydra          # disposable infra
cargo run --bin stub-adapter &               # :8080
cargo run --bin mcp-echo &                   # :3001
cargo run --bin lab_prove                    # drives P1-P7, prints PASS/FAIL per item
docker compose down -v                       # tear down disposable state
```

## Stop conditions (from the approved plan)

- If Hydra cannot safely produce the required JWT claims / audience / consent-approved scope intersection -> stop, propose Gate 2 revision. (P4/P5)
- If open DCR can broaden token authorization beyond explicit CommonCal consent -> stop, propose Gate 2 revision. (P5: consent intersection must hold even though DCR is open)
- No custom OAuth registration/token proxy to conceal either failure.
- Hydra admin API never exposed publicly (loopback only in the lab).
- No real secret values or tokens in Git, logs, fixtures, docs, or the final response.

1: //! Slice 2 CommonCal service — real session-based consent, grant storage,
2: //! and internal API for the MCP server.
3: //!
4: //! Replaces the Slice 1 fake auto-approver. This service:
5: //! - Has a login endpoint that creates a real session (cookie-based)
6: //! - Renders a consent page (HTML) that requires an authenticated session
7: //! - Creates a unique mcp_grant transactionally on approve (grant-first)
8: //! - Provides an internal API for the MCP server to fetch calendars and grants
9: //! - Supports grant revocation (immediate, otherwise-valid JWT becomes 403)
10: //!
11: //! All state is in-memory (lab-only). The real system uses SQLite.
12: //! No real secrets are stored; the bridge key and session tokens are lab values.
13:

333:     // -- magic-link helpers -------------------------------------------------

335:     /// Create a single-use magic-link token bound to (email, continue_url).
336:     /// Returns the opaque token. The `continue_url` is already validated to be
337:     /// a same-origin relative path by the caller.
338:     async fn create_magic_link(&self, email: &str, continue_url: &str) -> String {
339:         let token = format!("magic_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4().simple());
340:         let expires = Self::now() + 600;
341:         let mut st = self.inner.write().await;
342:         st.magic_links.insert(
343:             token.clone(),
344:             MagicLink {
345:                 email: email.to_string(),
346:                 continue_url: continue_url.to_string(),
347:                 expires_at: expires,
348:                 used: false,
349:             },
350:         );
351:         token
352:     }

354:     /// Consume a magic-link token. Returns (email, continue_url) if valid and
355:     /// unused; None if unknown, expired, or already used (single-use).
356:     async fn verify_magic_link(&self, token: &str) -> Option<(String, String)> {
357:         let mut st = self.inner.write().await;
358:         let link = st.magic_links.get_mut(token)?;
359:         if link.used || link.expires_at < Self::now() {
360:             return None;
361:         }
362:         link.used = true;
363:         Some((link.email.clone(), link.continue_url.clone()))
364:     }

431:     // -- grant helpers ------------------------------------------------------

433:     /// Create a unique mcp_grant for (user_id, oauth_client_id).
434:     /// Replaces any existing active grant (no union — replace semantics).
435:     /// Returns the grant ID.
436:     async fn upsert_grant(
437:         &self,
438:         user_id: i64,
439:         oauth_client_id: &str,
440:         allowed_calendar_ids: Vec<i64>,
441:         scopes: Vec<String>,
442:     ) -> String {
443:         let now = Self::now();
444:         let mut st = self.inner.write().await;
445: 
446:         // Revoke any existing active grant for this (user, client) pair.
447:         // This is "replace rather than union" semantics.
448:         for grant in st.grants.values_mut() {
449:             if grant.user_id == user_id
450:                 && grant.oauth_client_id == oauth_client_id
451:                 && grant.revoked_at.is_none()
452:             {
453:                 grant.revoked_at = Some(now);
454:             }
455:         }
456: 
457:         let grant_id = format!("grant_{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4().simple());
458:         let grant = McpGrant {
459:             id: grant_id.clone(),
460:             user_id,
461:             oauth_client_id: oauth_client_id.to_string(),
462:             allowed_calendar_ids,
463:             scopes,
464:             created_at: now,
465:             revoked_at: None,
466:         };
467:         st.grants.insert(grant_id.clone(), grant);
468:         debug!(grant_id, user_id, oauth_client_id, "mcp_grant created");
469:         grant_id
470:     }

481:             })
482:             .cloned()

487:         let now = Self::now();
488:         let mut st = self.inner.write().await;
489:         let mut revoked = false;

491:             if grant.user_id == user_id
492:                 && grant.oauth_client_id == oauth_client_id
493:                 && grant.revoked_at.is_none()
494:             {
495:                 grant.revoked_at = Some(now);

498:         }
499:         if revoked {
500:             debug!(user_id, oauth_client_id, "mcp_grant revoked");

555:     // -- Slice 6: event + availability helpers ------------------------------
556: 
557:     /// Parse a UTC timestamp (ISO 8601 or Unix epoch) to i64 seconds.
558:     fn parse_ts(s: &str) -> Option<i64> {
559:         if let Ok(ts) = s.parse::<i64>() {
560:             return Some(ts);
561:         }
562:         chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(s)
563:             .ok()
564:             .map(|dt| dt.timestamp())
565:     }
566: 
567:     /// Compute availability slots for a calendar in [from, to].
568:     /// A slot is "busy" if an event overlaps it, otherwise "free".
569:     /// Slots are 1-hour blocks aligned to the hour.
570:     async fn compute_availability(
571:         &self,
572:         calendar_id: i64,
573:         from: &str,
574:         to: &str,
575:     ) -> Vec<serde_json::Value> {
576:         let from_ts = Self::parse_ts(from).unwrap_or(0);
577:         let to_ts = Self::parse_ts(to).unwrap_or(0);
578:         let events: Vec<Event> = {
579:             let st = self.inner.read().await;
580:             st.events
581:                 .values()
582:                 .filter(|e| e.calendar_id == calendar_id)
583:                 .cloned()
584:                 .collect()
585:         };
586: 
587:         let mut slots = Vec::new();
588:         let mut t = from_ts;
589:         while t < to_ts {
590:             let slot_end = (t + 3600).min(to_ts);
591:             let busy = events.iter().any(|e| {
592:                 e.start_utc.is_some_and(|s| s < slot_end) && e.end_utc.is_some_and(|en| en > t)
593:             });
594:             slots.push(serde_json::json!({
595:                 "start": t,
596:                 "end": slot_end,
597:                 "status": if busy { "busy" } else { "free" },
598:             }));
599:             t = slot_end;
600:         }
601:         slots
602:     }
603: 
604:     /// Get a single event by (calendar_id, event_id).
605:     async fn get_event(&self, calendar_id: i64, event_id: i64) -> Option<Event> {
606:         let st = self.inner.read().await;
607:         st.events
608:             .get(&event_id)
609:             .filter(|e| e.calendar_id == calendar_id)
610:             .cloned()
611:     }

613:     /// Search events in a calendar within [from, to], optionally filtered by query.
614:     async fn search_events(
615:         &self,
616:         calendar_id: i64,
617:         from: &str,
618:         to: &str,
619:         query: Option<&str>,
620:     ) -> Vec<Event> {
621:         let from_ts = Self::parse_ts(from).unwrap_or(0);
622:         let to_ts = Self::parse_ts(to).unwrap_or(0);
623:         let st = self.inner.read().await;
624:         let mut results: Vec<Event> = st
625:             .events
626:             .values()
627:             .filter(|e| e.calendar_id == calendar_id)
628:             .filter(|e| {
629:                 e.start_utc.is_some_and(|s| s >= from_ts && s <= to_ts)
630:                     || e.end_utc.is_some_and(|en| en >= from_ts && en <= to_ts)
631:             })
632:             .filter(|e| {

856:     /// Look up a handoff from the auth server's private API.
857:     async fn lookup_interaction(&self, handoff: &str) -> Result<InteractionView, String> {
858:         let url = format!(
859:             "{}/internal/interactions/{}",
860:             self.auth_private_base,
861:             urlencoding::encode(handoff)
862:         );
863:         let resp = self
864:             .http
865:             .get(&url)
866:             .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", self.bridge_key))
867:             .send()
868:             .await
869:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
870:         let status = resp.status();
871:         if !status.is_success() {
872:             let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
873:             tracing::error!(status = %status, body = %body, "lookup_interaction failed");
874:             return Err(format!("interaction lookup failed: {status} {body}"));
875:         }
876:         let body = resp.text().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
877:         let view: InteractionView =
878:             serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|e| format!("parse interaction view: {e}"))?;
879:         Ok(view)
880:     }

882:     /// Decide a handoff (login/consent/deny) via the auth server's private API.
883:     /// `subject` is the authenticated CommonCal user id (the identity authority
884:     /// is CommonCal; the auth server binds the provider grant to this subject
885:     /// rather than a hardcoded value). Returns the resume URL.
886:     ///
887:     /// Honors the lab bridge-failure test hook: if armed, this call fails
888:     /// (simulating a bridge timeout) and the hook decrements, so a retry
889:     /// succeeds — proving grant-first / bridge-second idempotent retry.
890:     async fn decide_interaction(
891:         &self,
892:         handoff: &str,
893:         kind: &str,
894:         subject: Option<i64>,
895:     ) -> Result<String, String> {
896:         // Lab test hook: simulate a bridge failure on the next CONSENT decide
897:         // call(s). Only consent decisions are affected — the grant-first /
898:         // bridge-second ordering is a consent-path property, and login decisions
899:         // must not be disrupted (they precede the grant write).
900:         if kind == "consent" {
901:             let mut st = self.inner.write().await;
902:             if st.decide_fail_remaining > 0 {
903:                 st.decide_fail_remaining -= 1;
904:                 tracing::warn!("simulating bridge decide failure (test hook)");
905:                 return Err("simulated bridge timeout (test hook)".to_string());
906:             }
907:         }
908: 
909:         let url = format!(
910:             "{}/internal/interactions/{}",
911:             self.auth_private_base,
912:             urlencoding::encode(handoff)
913:         );
914:         let mut body = serde_json::json!({ "kind": kind });
915:         if let Some(sub) = subject {
916:             body["subject"] = serde_json::json!(sub);
917:         }
918:         let resp = self
919:             .http
920:             .put(&url)
921:             .header("Authorization", format!("Bearer {}", self.bridge_key))
922:             .json(&body)
923:             .send()
924:             .await
925:             .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
926:         let status = resp.status();
927:         if !status.is_success() {
928:             let text = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
929:             tracing::error!(status = %status, text = %text, "decide_interaction failed");
930:             return Err(format!("interaction decide failed: {status} {text}"));
931:         }
932:         let result: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
933:         result
934:             .get("resumeUrl")
935:             .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
936:             .map(|s| s.to_string())
937:             .ok_or_else(|| "decide response missing resumeUrl".to_string())
938:     }
939: }

954: /// GET /consent?handoff=...
955: ///
956: /// If the interaction prompt is "login" and the user has a session, decide
957: /// login immediately (redirect to resume URL). If the prompt is "consent",
958: /// render the consent page. If no session, redirect to /login.
959: async fn consent_page(
960:     State(state): State<AppState>,
961:     Query(q): Query<ConsentQuery>,
962:     headers: HeaderMap,
963: ) -> Response {
964:     let handoff = match &q.handoff {
965:         Some(h) if !h.is_empty() => h.clone(),
966:         _ => {
967:             return (
968:                 StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
969:                 Json(serde_json::json!({"error": "missing_handoff"})),
970:             )
971:                 .into_response();
972:         }
973:     };
974: 
975:     // Look up the interaction from the auth server.
976:     let view = match state.lookup_interaction(&handoff).await {
977:         Ok(v) => v,
978:         Err(e) => {
979:             return (
980:                 StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
981:                 Json(serde_json::json!({"error": e})),
982:             )
983:                 .into_response();
984:         }
985:     };
986: 
987:     // Check if the user has a session.
988:     let session_token = extract_session_cookie(&headers);
989:     let user_id = match &session_token {
990:         Some(t) => state.get_session(t).await,
991:         None => None,
992:     };
993: 
994:     // If no session, redirect to login with a continue param.
995:     let continue_url = format!("/consent?handoff={}", urlencoding::encode(&handoff));
996:     let (session_token, user_id) = match (&session_token, user_id) {
997:         (Some(t), Some(uid)) => (t.clone(), uid),
998:         _ => {
999:             let location = format!("/login?continue={}", urlencoding::encode(&continue_url));
1000:             return (StatusCode::SEE_OTHER, [(header::LOCATION, location)]).into_response();
1001:         }
1002:     };
1003: 
1004:     // If the prompt is "login", decide login immediately (user is authenticated).
1005:     if view.prompt == "login" {
1006:         match state
1007:             .decide_interaction(&handoff, "login", Some(user_id))
1008:             .await
1009:         {
1010:             Ok(resume_url) => {
1011:                 return (StatusCode::SEE_OTHER, [(header::LOCATION, resume_url)]).into_response();
1012:             }
1013:             Err(e) => {
1014:                 return (
1015:                     StatusCode::BAD_GATEWAY,
1016:                     Json(serde_json::json!({"error": e})),
1017:                 )
1018:                     .into_response();
1019:             }
1020:         }
1021:     }
1022: 
1023:     // If the prompt is "consent", render the consent page.
1024:     if view.prompt == "consent" {
1025:         let csrf_token = state.create_csrf(&session_token).await;
1026:         let scopes_html: Vec<String> = view
1027:             .requested_scopes
1028:             .iter()
1029:             .map(|s| format!("<li>{}</li>", escape_html(s)))
1030:             .collect();
1031:         let html = format!(
1032:             r#"<!DOCTYPE html>
1033: <html lang="en">
1034: <head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>CommonCal — Authorize</title>
1035: <style>body{{font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;max-width:480px;margin:2rem auto;padding:0 1rem}}
1036: .card{{border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:8px;padding:1.5rem;margin-top:1rem}}
1037: button{{padding:.5rem 1rem;margin-right:.5rem;cursor:pointer;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #ccc}}
1038: .approve{{background:#22c55e;color:#fff;border-color:#16a34a}}
1039: .deny{{background:#fff;color:#dc2626;border-color:#dc2626}}
1040: ul{{padding-left:1.2rem}}</style></head>
1041: <body>
1042: <h1>Authorize access</h1>
1043: <div class="card">
1044: <p><strong>{}</strong> is requesting access to your CommonCal account.</p>
1045: <p>Requested permissions:</p>
1046: <ul>{}</ul>
1047: <form method="POST" action="/consent/decision">
1048: <input type="hidden" name="handoff" value="{}">
1049: <input type="hidden" name="csrf" value="{}">
1050: <button type="submit" name="decision" value="approve" class="approve">Approve</button>
1051: <button type="submit" name="decision" value="deny" class="deny">Deny</button>
1052: </form>
1053: </div>
1054: </body></html>"#,
1055:             escape_html(&view.client_name),
1056:             scopes_html.join(""),
1057:             escape_html(&handoff),
1058:             escape_html(&csrf_token),
1059:         );
1060:         return (
1061:             StatusCode::OK,
1062:             [(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html; charset=utf-8")],
1063:             html,
1064:         )
1065:             .into_response();
1066:     }
1067: 
1068:     // Unknown prompt — deny.
1069:     (
1070:         StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
1071:         Json(serde_json::json!({"error": "unknown_prompt", "prompt": view.prompt})),
1072:     )
1073:         .into_response()

1191: async fn magic_link_verify(
1192:     State(state): State<AppState>,
1193:     Query(q): Query<MagicLinkQuery>,
1194: ) -> Response {
1195:     let Some(token) = q.token.filter(|t| !t.is_empty()) else {
1196:         return (StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, "missing token").into_response();
1197:     };
1198: 
1199:     let Some((email, continue_url)) = state.verify_magic_link(&token).await else {
1200:         // Unknown, expired, or already-used token (single-use).
1201:         return (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, "invalid or expired magic link").into_response();
1202:     };
1203: 
1204:     let user_id = {
1205:         let st = state.inner.read().await;
1206:         st.users.get(&email).map(|u| u.id)
1207:     };
1208:     let Some(user_id) = user_id else {
1209:         return (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, "unknown user").into_response();
1210:     };

1212:     let session_token = state.create_session(user_id).await;
1213:     let set_cookie = format!(
1214:         "commoncal_session={}; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax",
1215:         session_token
1216:     );
1217:     (
